_note: ad-draft output. SHAPE: this file is the human EXAMPLE of the canonical beats.json contract in `cloops-ads/domain/beats.ts` (`BeatsFile`) — the engine enforces that type; change fields THERE, not by inventing them here. `coordinate` = EVERY pick (the full address): targeting (persona/pain/mechanism/angle) + `concept`=vehicle (char-3p-drama | text-on-gameplay | short-drama | ugc | app-demo | kinetic-text) + format + length + `treatment`=look + voice + music + character/lock/style/anchor. `beats` = the script (separate; the agent writes it). The engine lifts `coordinate.*` to the top level at load. `character` is OPTIONAL (omit for text-only vehicles); a NON-default protagonist REQUIRES character + lock + a gender-matched voice. Voice MUST gender-match the character. NEVER use the word 'storyboard' in a t2i prompt, use 'film still'. `format` = platform deliverable (video | image | image-carousel). `length` = creative FORM band (micro | short | mid | long); the band is chosen, exact seconds are DERIVED by the PRODUCER from the VO, never written-to. Beats carry NO `duration` , the producer owns all timing (it sizes each i2v clip AND the final cut from the measured VO + breath, VO-first). `language` reserved for later. Claymation defaults (Maria/Rachel) inherit when lock/style/voice/character are omitted. MULTI-SHOT: this 5-row scaffold is a DEFAULT, not a limit. Split a beat into multiple rows (symptom-a, symptom-b) ONLY when you want several DISTINCT VISUALS across it (a creative choice); keep each `role` UNIQUE (assets are named by role), one clip per row. You do NOT split for timing , the producer auto-covers any single beat whose VO exceeds the 15s i2v cap.

coordinate.lock: <one-sentence character LOCK; omit for claymation default or text-only>
coordinate.style: <look STYLE token; omit to inherit the default>

beats.i2v: Global: preserve character and look from the start image. Subtle motion: small natural gesture. No redesign.
beats.vo: <hook line — opens IN the raw pain (Path A); for universal pains the faith enters via the angle here>

_variants_note: OPTIONAL. Pre-authored or planned variants of THIS base, each a single-cell DELTA (the base's produced pool is reused; a variant is NOT a copy of the ad). One shared shape across ad-draft (hook openers) and ad-iterate (any cell). Each entry: { id: '<ad-id>__<cell>-<tag>', scope: 'whole-ad'|'per-beat', layer: 'in-picture'|'on-top' (decides cost: in-picture=regen, on-top=swap), cell: 'voice'|'music'|'look'|'character'|'visual'|'line', beat: '<role, only when scope=per-beat>', value: <the new value>, status: 'idea'|'produced' }. Example, a hook opener: { id:'<ad-id>__line-hookB', scope:'per-beat', layer:'on-top', cell:'line', beat:'hook', value:'<opener text>', status:'idea' }.
